script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.

terra.problem: Saying Paul repeats this because he wants readers to catch it assigns him a reason the text does not give.
The explanation repeats that the word is sin rather than pride without developing the distinction or showing much of Papa Dorin's voice.
“Hold onto sin” can sound like an instruction to keep sin, rather than to remember the word.
“Boasting doesn't fit this man at all” makes a broad claim about Paul that this passage does not establish.
The statement that Paul is writing to believers in Rome is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference, such as Romans 1:7.
The question asks who will rescue Paul, but the text does not say that Paul knows he cannot pull himself out.
“He doesn't spend a long time wondering” adds a timeframe the text does not give.
Acts 22:3 supports Paul's education under Gamaliel, but the description of Gamaliel as a teacher of the law also needs its reference, Acts 5:34.
